import time

    text: str

    text = (
        f"Automated account here. On {topic}, I support policies that improve outcomes. "
        f"Source: {sources[0]}"
    )
    return DraftPost(text=text, sources=sources)

def compliance_check(draft: DraftPost) -> bool:

    if "Automated account" not in draft.text:
        return False  # transparency
    if len(draft.text) > 280:
        return False  # typical microblog constraint
    if not draft.sources:
        return False  # encourage citations
